reason: It is a pretty carousel about a concept, labelled 'not a live product', with no client, no result and no number from a real till. I follow studios for their work, but I would not hand my money or my payment checks to a design studio on the strength of a story slide.
objection: I do not see real clients or results. Where is one business that ran this and what changed?
would_change_my_mind: A named client, or a live trial on my own till data showing it catches a fake payment before I release goods, with the results shown to me first.
